translations.Jo flere filer og lag en modell må hoppe: The more files and layers a model has to jump between, the faster it loses track. I keep the code flat, gather shared data in one place instead of spreading it across multiple files, and clean up structural noise along the way. This keeps the context down to 100 to 200 lines at a time and makes the code easy to understand for both the team and my future self.
translations.Når tempoet øker, blir sikkerhetsnettet: When the pace increases, the safety net becomes even more important. I work in small, frequent commits and keep refactoring separate from new features, so it is always safe to roll back and easy for others to follow the history. Before changes go to production, I check them with automated tests and a review of critical user flows.
translations.På GitHub ligger det mange raske eksperi: On GitHub, there are many quick experiments where I am just testing a tool or an idea on the fly. They work fine as scratchpads. The projects I show here are built to hold up when you look under the hood, where my own choices drive the architecture, flow, and details.

translations.MedCare Clinical ble bygget over fem uke: MedCare Clinical was built over five weeks as the final exam project for the two year backend development program at Noroff. The assignment was to plan, model, and develop a complete clinic appointment booking system in C# and .NET 9 with MySQL and a corresponding React client.
translations.Før jeg skrev en eneste linje C#, brukte: Before writing a single line of C#, I spent the first few days reviewing the requirements specification, refreshing my knowledge of normalization, and drawing the ER diagram in third normal form (3NF). Among other things, I separated cities, categories, and statuses into their own tables linked to clinics and appointments.
translations.Da modellene og relasjonene var satt opp: Once the models and relations were set up in Entity Framework Core, I wanted to be certain that the C# code produced the exact database structure I had planned. I ran mysqldump from MySQL and imported the schema back into dbdiagram.io to verify that tables, foreign keys, and unique indexes matched the ER diagram.
translations.Etter hvert som antallet entiteter og DT: As the number of entities and DTO objects grew, manual mapping in the service layer became cluttered. I considered libraries like AutoMapper and Mapperly, but chose to write custom extension methods in C# (such as ToAppointmentWithDetailsDTO and ToClinicDTO) along with an UpdateWith helper method for partial updates. This kept the services readable without adding extra packages.
translations.Samme uke endret jeg fødselsnummer (Nati: That same week, I changed the national identity number property from an integer to an 11 character string, since Norwegian ID numbers can start with 0 and are never used for mathematical calculations.
translations.For å hindre dobbeltbooking la jeg først: To prevent double booking, I initially added composite unique indexes in the database on DoctorId + AppointmentDate and PatientId + AppointmentDate. During testing, I discovered that the index only stopped two appointments starting at the exact same minute, but failed to block a new booking at 10:15 if the doctor already had a 30 minute appointment from 10:00 to 10:30.
translations.Jeg måtte sette meg ned med penn og papi: I had to sit down with pen and paper to map out the timelines to be 100 percent sure the date validation caught all variations of overlaps, both for new bookings and when a registered patient modifies an existing appointment.
translations.I starten av arbeidet med frontenden bru: Early in the frontend development, I used Zustand for everything, including fetching lists of doctors and appointments. This resulted in a lot of repetitive code and unnecessary useEffect calls. Even though I was behind schedule after catching the flu halfway through the project, I decided to refactor data fetching to TanStack Query (using useQuery, useMutation, and useInfiniteQuery with backend pagination), while keeping only pure client state like the active token and theme in Zustand.

translations.Arkitektur og sikkerhet: Delt 3D modell: Architecture and security: Shared 3D model with 20 blendshapes running in a dedicated OffscreenCanvas Web Worker at 60 fps, paired with real time TTS, speech to text, and prompt injection defenses.

translations.Avataren er en 3D skanning av meg med 20: The avatar is a 3D scan of me with 20 blendshapes for lip sync, blinking, and facial expressions, combined with skeletal neck and head tracking. So the 3D view never blocks the main thread or slows down scrolling, the canvas runs inside a dedicated OffscreenCanvas Web Worker (avatar.worker.ts).
translations.En og samme WebGL og Worker instans flyt: A single shared WebGL and Worker instance moves directly via a DOM portal between the front page hero, the floating corner dock, and the fullscreen studio (/chat), loading the 3D model only once in memory. Three.js boots on first interaction and pauses automatically via IntersectionObserver whenever the avatar leaves the viewport.

translations.Å bruke KI til sparring på egen maskin e: Using AI for sparring on your own machine is straightforward. Things change as soon as you put a public chat online, let it control what happens on the screen, and let it reply in your own cloned voice. Simon Willison describes this risk well in The Lethal Trifecta. Data leaks happen when an AI system combines three things at once, which are access to private data, text or audio from outside, and the ability to send data back out to the internet.

translations.Til slutt skrev jeg om datahentingen i R: Finally, I rewrote the data fetching in React from Zustand to TanStack Query with backend pagination, short lived JWT tokens in memory, and role based access for admins.
translations.I Cinemorra er App Router delt i egne ru: In Cinemorra, the App Router is divided into dedicated route groups for the public movie catalog and a protected admin panel controlled via middleware.
translations.Kort fortalt har denne porteføljen ingen: In short, this portfolio has no user accounts, no tracking cookies, and no database storing what you type or say in the chat. Here is an open overview of what happens under the hood.
translations.Før jeg utdannet meg i backendutvikling: Before studying backend and frontend development at Noroff, I worked at Ekornes. I started on the production floor assembling furniture and programming Motoman industrial robots before moving on to team lead and department manager with responsibility for staff, daily operations planning, and quality control. That background is why I like contributing with more than just code, such as understanding the business and daily operations, taking part in legal considerations (like contracts, privacy, and business rules), and being part of the bigger decisions.

translations.Etter mye egen prøving og feiling landet: After plenty of trial and error on my own, I landed on a rhythm that turned out to be an established method called Spike and Stabilize, described by Dan North. First, I build a quick initial version all the way from database to UI (Spike) to see if the idea actually works. Once the core feature holds up, I switch to Stabilize where I clear away noise, handle edge cases, and get the code ready for production.
translations.VGS Bordtennis startet som et forsøk på: VGS Bordtennis started as an effort to include more students during recess, aiming to make something fun that made it easier to join in around the table tennis tables and be active together. It is a real time system in Node.js for tournaments and a big screen scoreboard, using a QR code at the table.
translations.I slike TV nettlesere krever systemet et: In these TV browsers, the system requires a physical user click before a <video> is allowed to play. If you call video.play() in an iframe without a click, the browser does not throw an error, it simply leaves the promise pending forever so the video freezes on the first frame. Chromium also throttles timers in cross domain iframes to full minute boundaries, skipping standard second based polling.

translations.Kim og jeg tar jevnlige statusmøter der: Kim and I hold regular status meetings where we review the road ahead for the company, set strategy, and divide tasks between us. My responsibility is everything that meets the user visually and in the frontend, from the brand, design system, and marketing pages to keeping the user experience calm, readable, and tidy on both mobile and desktop.
translations.Denne oppryddingen viste en viktig detal: This cleanup revealed an important detail in how EF Core builds SQL. As long as the mapping lived directly inside a .Select(a => new DTO { Doctor = ... }) expression, EF Core knew to fetch the Doctor relation automatically. When I switched to .Select(a => a.ToAppointmentWithDetailsDTO()), EF Core could no longer read the expression tree and threw an error because related data was missing. The fix was to add explicit calls to .Include() in the queries.
translations.Samme oppsett har tydelig nytteverdi i a: The same setup is useful in other industries. In healthcare, it can give older adults and patients calm spoken guidance through forms and preparation. In schools, students can practice speaking in a safe setting, and in customer support, companies can guide users visually through an issue without the model making up its own answers.
translations.For å skille de åpne sidene tydelig fra: To separate the public pages cleanly from administration, the app uses route groups in the Next.js App Router, with an open section ((home)) where visitors can filter by genre, search the catalog, watch trailers, and read reviews, and a protected section ((dashboard)/admin) for adding, editing, and deleting movies.

translations.Sanntidsstatus på bordene (opptatt i kam: Real time table status (busy in a match or available) and who currently holds the table.
translations.Spillerens aktive rekkert, seiersprosent: Active paddle, win rate, time at the table, trophies, and paddle trades.

translations.Ut fra dette bygde jeg opp budskapet run: From there, I built the messaging around fast Vipps payments without long forms, fully reconciled accounting with Tripletex and Fiken, and a system ready in one day.
translations.Før jeg skrev kode tegnet jeg databasen: Before writing code, I sketched the database in third normal form and imported the schema from MySQL back into dbdiagram to check that tables and unique indexes matched the plan.
translations.Etter hvert som modellene vokste skrev j: As the models grew, I wrote custom extension mappers in C sharp instead of AutoMapper, and discovered that EF Core requires explicit calls to Include when mapping moves out of Select.
translations.For å sikre mot prompt injection ligger: To guard against prompt injection, the checks live in regular TypeScript code around the model, where messages are sanitized and all tags controlling the page are checked against fixed lists on the server and client.
translations.Repoet er delt i tre moduler som styrer: The repo is split into three modules that manage calm surfaces and colors in the UI, lean architecture with short context, and natural language where motivation comes before technical details.
translations.Innlogging, utlån og filmendringer går g: Logins, rentals, and movie updates run through Server Actions with clean UI state in Zustand, while search, forms, and accessibility are tested with Jest and React Testing Library.
translations.Siden ulike skoler og friminutt har fors: Since different schools and breaks have different needs, the tournament engine supports an open ladder (King of the Hill with automatic signup at the table), playoff brackets, and Swiss style where everyone gets to play all the way to the end.
translations.For å skape samhold på tvers av trinn ha: To build community across grades, the system has dedicated class teams and digital paddles with local character from the school and the Innlandet region. Each paddle tracks matches, wins, and past owners before unlocked paddles move to the school trophy vault when third year students graduate.
translations.Løsningen er bygget i Node.js med inneby: The system is built in Node.js using built in node:sqlite in WAL mode and only 5 npm packages. Multiple schools run separately on the same instance via school_id and dedicated Socket.IO rooms inside a Docker container on Fly.io in Stockholm, stress tested with 100 concurrent players without errors.
translations.Tilgangsstyringen bygger på 4-nivås RBAC: Access control uses four tier RBAC based on least privilege and separation of duties: student, staff player, local school organizer locked to their own school, IT operations across schools, and a dedicated system owner account for destructive actions like school year rollover and deleting schools.
translations.Personvern (GDPR art. 25) ligger rett i: Privacy (GDPR Article 25) is built directly into the data model with no open chat between students. The moment an adult organizer approves a student, names and emails are permanently deleted from the database so only nicknames and a one way HMAC-SHA256 hash remain. Organizers can also export anonymous activity reports to A4 and Excel without external packages.
translations.Resultater etter tre dager i kantina: Results after three days in the cafeteria
translations.På bare tre dager ble det spilt nittisek: In just three days, ninety six completed matches were played with fourteen hours of physical movement, where the table was in play almost the entire lunch break and the students handled everything themselves.
translations.Medgründer, med ansvar for merkevare, de: Co founder, responsible for brand identity, design, copy, frontend, and user experience
translations.Fullført skoleprosjekt, live demo og åpe: Completed school project, live demo and open source
translations.På de tre første skoledagene gikk aktivi: Over the first three school days, activity grew from 4 matches on Monday to 26 on Tuesday and 66 on Wednesday, resulting in 96 completed matches and 14 hours of active movement among students. Between 11 am and 1 pm on Wednesday, the table was in play for 55 out of 60 minutes each hour (93 percent of the time), with only a 13 second gap between pairs. Without any instructions from adults, the students naturally changed the rules on Wednesday from best of three sets to a single set to 21 points to clear the waiting queue.
translations.Alle de 27 aktive spillerne (8 av 10 reg: All 27 active players (8 out of 10 registered students) played across different groups in 48 unique pairings, including matches against teachers in the cafeteria. Between 60 and 80 percent returned the next day, and the students played 12 extra matches purely for fun after their daily point quota was filled.
translations.Nesten alt styrte seg selv ved bordet ut: Almost everything ran autonomously at the table without a referee (96 percent of the matches). Both players confirmed the score on their phones in about 4 seconds before handing the paddle over, and in nearly 3 out of 10 matches, it was the losing player who entered the result. After the first week, we added schedule controls and simple nickname moderation, and the next steps include a second table during lunch, fixed weekly rounds where students vote on the format, and class versus class team matches.
translations.Når to spillere skanner QR koden ved sam: When two players scan the QR code at the same table within 45 seconds, they are paired up and the match starts automatically. They can put their phone in their pocket while playing the sets, and afterwards one player taps quick buttons for the score (1-0, 2-0, or 2-1) while the opponent confirms with a single tap. The table is freed up immediately and remembers the winner for 20 minutes, so the next challenger can scan and tap Play against winner directly.
translations.Elever uten konto kommer rett i kamp som: Students without an account enter a match immediately as guests and can accumulate up to 3 wins on hold, which transfer automatically once they create a profile afterwards. Since iOS separates storage between Safari and home screen apps (PWAs), the session syncs via the manifest when students scan using the camera. Daily quotas per player pair and alerts for unnaturally fast matches stop point cheating, while teachers participate as Boss without taking up slots on the student leaderboard.
translations.Løsningen ble å lage alle animasjoner på: The solution was to build all animations on the big screen using ffmpeg as 24 fps animated WebP inside a picture element with a GIF fallback. The main display is first delivered as ready HTML from the server (SSR), upgraded to real time Socket.IO in modern browsers, and features a dedicated client in vanilla ES5 (with 3 second polling and measurement of actual elapsed time) for older TV screens. Fallback displays can be tested directly in a regular browser using ?mode=es5 and ?mode=ssr.
translations.Nederst til høyre viser skjermen aktiv m: In the bottom right corner, the screen shows the active mode (LIVE, POLL, ES5, or SSR) and reloads itself automatically when a new version is rolled out. Outside of school hours, the big screen goes into sleep mode and wakes up again at the start of the next school day.
translations.To konkrete kunder la føringene for både: Two specific clients shaped the positioning, copy, and structure of the website. Ronny at Honndalen Gym og Sauna runs a gym, group classes, and sauna, and previously spent up to a full workday each month pulling reports, cross checking Vipps payments in Excel, and entering receipts manually into Tripletex.
translations.Deving innen ATV utleie og naturopplevel: An ATV rental and outdoor adventure business on the west coast was tired of established rental systems (like Periode.no, Gibbs, and Sharefox) that market themselves as simple, but in practice require long training periods and are packed with features the business does not need.
translations.Innsikten fra bedriftseierne gjorde det: The insights from the business owners made it easy to strip away vague marketing jargon. Where older systems often force guests through long forms and account creation just to book an appointment, Ember lets customers sign up and pay in seconds using Vipps or card (Stripe and PayPal).
translations.Samtidig avstemmes alle transaksjoner au: At the same time, all transactions are reconciled automatically against Tripletex and Fiken while SMS and email notifications go out with every reservation, meaning the business owner only needs to review the numbers. The entire system is stripped down to the features rental businesses actually use day to day, and is ready to use in a single day without training courses.
translations.Selve oppbyggingen av emberbooking.no (b: The structure of emberbooking.no (built in Next.js 16) is designed to answer the questions and doubts a business owner has before switching systems. At the top, visitors meet the message One booking system for all your resources, a brief explanation of how booking, payment, and accounting connect, a clear call to action, and low friction with no lock in period.
translations.Rett under viser tre enkle kort forskjel: Right below, three simple cards show the difference from heavier competitors, before the page puts words to the frustration of Excel sheets and manual exports and presents the automated solution. Further down the page are industry cards (such as sauna with planned control of stove and lighting, fitness centers, and ATV and car rentals) along with customer stories from pilot clients saving 5 to 7 hours a month, before transparent pricing and FAQs round things off ahead of the final call to action.
translations.Tidlig i uke 1 satte jeg også opp en sen: Early in week 1, I also set up a centralized GlobalExceptionHandler so the service layer could avoid repetitive try/catch blocks in every method, configured Swagger at /doc with XML comments, example data, and response codes, and added GitHub Actions CI so no push could silently break the build.
translations.Pasienter uten konto kan bestille time m: Patients without an account can book an appointment with their name, date of birth, phone number, and email. If the same person books again later or creates a full user account, the backend reuses and upgrades the existing patient row instead of creating duplicates. Canceled appointments use soft delete so the history remains in the database without blocking the time slot for new patients.
translations.Innloggingen bruker kortlivede access to: The login uses short lived access tokens (1 to 15 minutes) kept only in memory. When a protected endpoint returns 401, the client automatically calls POST /api/Auth/refresh with a 7 day httpOnly cookie and renews access without the user noticing. To prevent regular patients from modifying clinics, cities, and specialties, I added a dedicated Role table (Patient and Admin) and locked down write endpoints with [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")].
translations.I innspurten brukte jeg react-scan for å: During the final push, I used react-scan to clear out unnecessary view updates, consolidated duplicated JWT setup into JWTTokenValidationParameters, moved CORS settings out to appsettings.json, and shifted all sorting and filtering of appointments from the frontend over to the backend.
translations.Besøkende kan også snakke direkte inn vi: Visitors can also speak directly into the microphone in the chat through /api/transcribe, which features a custom glossary for project names and technical terms. The system prompt is built dynamically from the same data source as the rest of the site (projects.ts and portfolio.ts), with clear boundaries for what the model should answer and when it should redirect people to email.
translations.Når en språkmodell får styre hva som skj: When a language model controls what happens on the page and also replies with my own cloned voice, you cannot trust inputs coming from the browser blindly. The setup therefore follows the principle in Simon Willisons The Lethal Trifecta. Since the chat is open to outside messages, the model has neither access to private data nor the ability to send data back out to the internet, and the security checks live in regular TypeScript code surrounding the model.
translations.Modellen har ingen database eller verktø: The model has no database or tool calls and sees only the public text on the site. Bubbles appear as plain text in React without external images, and the browser is restricted to fetching and sending data exclusively on its own domain. The system prompt is assembled solely from fixed files on the server, chat messages are sanitized before submission, and the server verifies that previous responses in the thread are actually genuine so no one can forge the conversation.
translations.Alle tagger som bytter side eller scroll: All tags that switch pages or scroll to projects are checked against a fixed list of valid pages on both server and client, and the CV is only released when you actually request it. Before a response is sent to voice cloning, the code checks the length and blocks attempts to make the voice read unwanted text. All calls for chat, voice, and speech to text run with storage disabled at Gemini, alongside origin checks and fixed per minute and per day quotas in memory.
translations.Repoet er delt inn i tre moduler slik at: The repo is divided into three modules so each task only loads the rules it actually needs.
translations.Modulen lean-architecture holder konteks: The lean-architecture module keeps context short and requires data models and platform requirements to be locked down on paper and in AGENTS.md prior to coding. It builds on Dan Norths Spike and Stabilize, a single source for shared data, small and safe commits without mixing refactoring and new features, early cleanup of code smells, and documentation of silent production traps in README.md.
translations.Modulen natural-copy fjerner typiske KI: The natural-copy module removes typical AI habits in both Norwegian and English text, such as dashes, bullet point templates, empty clichés, and stiff translations. It also requires project texts and applications to start with human motivation before technical details.
translations.Søk, filtrering, skjemainnsending og fei: Search, filtering, form submission, and error messages are covered with component tests in Jest and React Testing Library, while eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y checks semantic form elements, clear focus indicators, and keyboard navigation automatically.
translations.Modulen ui-craft bygger på Matt D. Smith: The ui-craft module builds on Matt D. Smiths 3P approach of Purpose, Principles, and Personality, along with the gallery principle where the interface is colorless and products sit on clean white surfaces with deliberate dark contrasting bands. It cuts out glow effects, card shadows, glass pills, and sluggish page transitions in favor of tight 2px to 6px corners, light headings, fluid typography via Utopia.fyi with a maximum of 62 characters per line, and media that pauses when out of view.
translations.Siden chatten her skal være åpen for all: Since the chat here is open to everyone, the other two parts had to be cut completely. A language model just guesses the next word based on probability and can always be tricked, so the real security lies in ordinary TypeScript code surrounding the model. The model has no database or web tool calls and only sees the public text about my projects. The answers appear as plain text without external images, and the browser is locked to only talk to my own domain.
translations.Systemprompten bygges kun av faste filer: The system prompt is built only from static files on the server, while everything you write or say into the microphone is sanitized before being sent, and the server checks that previous answers in the thread actually come from here so no one can fake the conversation. The model is never allowed to pick arbitrary links or files on its own. Tags that switch pages or scroll to projects are checked against a fixed list on both the server and the client, the CV is only sent when you actually ask for it, and the code checks length and content before anything goes to the cloned voice.
translations.Alle kall til Gemini kjører med lagring: All calls to Gemini run with storage turned off, and the server checks that the request comes from my own site with strict quotas per minute and per day. I apply the same mindset locally when working with code agents, keeping untested MCP tools away from projects with production keys and using separate development keys with a fixed spending limit.

translations.Jeg har fulgt med på KI verktøy lenge, m: I have followed AI tools for a long time, but deliberately chose to keep them out of my two year backend education from 2024 to 2026. My goal was to make sure architecture, troubleshooting, and code quality became second nature before I started using coding agents, so AI was only used for simple brainstorming.
translations.Høsten 2026 bestemte jeg meg for å gi KI: In the autumn of 2026, I decided to give AI assisted software development a serious try with clear boundaries. By then, both the tools and the workflows had matured, and when AI handles more of the actual typing, I get more time on both ends of the project, both to plan the architecture properly at the start and to polish the user experience details at the end.
